description: This file defines a custom exception class 'SerializationConstructorNotFoundException' used within the Orleans.Serialization namespace. It includes constructors for initializing the exception with a specific type or serialization info, and is marked as serializable.

classes.description: A custom exception thrown when a type lacks a suitable serialization constructor within the Orleans.Serialization namespace.
